summary: Ascendis Pharma A/S filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing routine equity compensation: on November 10, 2026 the board granted 28,030 warrants to employees under Appendix 1a of the Articles, each exercisable for one ordinary share at US$256.59, the grant-date closing price. Vesting is 25% at one year and the balance in 1/36th monthly installments thereafter, subject to service and accelerated on certain exit events; the Articles were amended accordingly, with 1,431,143 shares still reserved. No transaction, stake or premium is involved; no arbitrage angle beyond modest dilution.
